subject: AWS private offer: revenue share carve-out & term deviation request
messages:
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@acmecloud.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer request — rev-share carve-out + extended payment terms

Hi Aditya / Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We had an internal review with procurement and the platform team and would like to move forward with a private offer on AWS Marketplace, but we need two deviations from standard terms to get legal/procurement comfortable: 

- Revenue share carve-out: AcmeCloud requires a 20% rev-share to our reseller channel for the first 6 months (your standard is 30%).
- Payment terms: procurement is asking for Net-90 to align with their vendor payment schedule (standard is Net-30).

Attached is a short pricing matrix and the term sheet our procurement team prefers (acme_requested_term_sheet.pdf). We expect initial usage to be modest (est. $120k ARR first 6 months) and have a formal renewal review at 90 days.

Can Redwood approve these deviations or escalate to the appropriate execs? We prefer to keep this as a private offer through AWS Marketplace rather than a direct invoice.

Happy to jump on a call tomorrow if helpful — propose 10:30am PT.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Tran
Head of Cloud Partnerships, AcmeCloud
Sophie.Tran@acmecloud.com
attachments: [redwood_acme_pricing_matrix.xlsx, acme_requested_term_sheet.pdf]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@acmecloud.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer request — rev-share carve-out + extended payment terms

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and for attaching the term sheet. We can certainly evaluate but will need to route this through Deal Desk + Finance + Legal. A few quick clarifying Qs before I escalate: 

1) You mentioned the 20% rev-share applies to the reseller channel for first 6 months — is that absolute or only for revenue attributable to that channel?
2) Can you confirm the expected first-6mo ARR of ~$120k is total Marketplace ARR (not just reseller-attributed)?
3) Is Acme okay accepting Net-60 as a compromise if Net-90 is a hard procurement requirement? Finance typically needs the shorter term or an onboarding credit hold.

I’ve looped in Lauren (RevOps) and Marissa (Marketplace lead) — I’ll escalate once we confirm the volume and channel attribution. Happy to take 10:30am PT tomorrow.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
phone: (415) 555-0125

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Private Offer request — rev-share carve-out + extended payment terms

Team — forwarding Sophie's ask. Quick internal assessment: 

- If they truly only expect $120k ARR in first 6 months, a 10ppt rev-share reduction (30% -> 20%) is approximately a $12k delta to Redwood gross on that initial period (rough estimate; depends on usage mix). If we model ARR growth to $400k next 12 months, the delta increases.
- Net-90 is a larger operational risk; Finance flags DSO increases and working capital impact. Net-60 is more palatable; if procurement insists on Net-90 we should consider a credit hold or initial pre-pay for first invoice. 
- Marketplace private offer is preferred by Acme — that helps with attribution and channel tracking, which is good.

Requesting escalation: we need an Exec-level signoff on (A) a temporary rev-share at 25% (compromise) for the first 90 days, and (B) Net-60 payment terms with Finance approval, plus Legal to accept the private offer term sheet redline. If Execs sign off we will deliver a one-page deviation memo for Procurement and generate the private offer.

Action items for approval: 
- Vivek: can you approve temporary 25% rev-share and Net-60 for a 90-day pilot (finance contingent)?
- Marissa: prep deviation memo, financial impact spreadsheet, and updated HubSpot deal (AC-2028-5543).

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-19T19:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Private Offer request — rev-share carve-out + extended payment terms

Team — thanks for the clear summary. I’m authorizing a controlled exception to accelerate this partnership but with firm guardrails: 

1) Approval: temporary rev-share set to 25% for an initial 90-day pilot period. After 90 days we will re-evaluate and revert to standard structure (or negotiate a staged ramp).
2) Payment terms: Net-60 only. If Procurement insists on Net-90 we require either a) initial invoice pre-pay for the first month or b) a 45-day credit hold with finance-provided limits; legal to include the clause.
3) Finance must sign the final deviation memo confirming DSO exposure and mitigation. Legal must complete redlines to the Acme term sheet before the private offer goes live.
4) No longer-term carve-outs or upstream reseller permanent splits without VP-level approval.

Marissa — please prepare the deviation memo and financial impact spreadsheet, get Legal and Finance to stamp, then I’ll countersign for the Exec approval path. Aditya — keep Acme in the loop; confirm they can accept Net-60 or one of the mitigation options.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Global Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@acmecloud.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@acmecloud.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-20T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer request — rev-share carve-out + extended payment terms

Hi Aditya / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and for escalating. We can accept the compromise: 25% rev-share for the 90-day pilot and Net-60 payment terms. Procurement will prepare the DocuSign routing but asked that Legal include the credit-hold clause you mentioned as contingency.

I’ve attached Acme's signed term sheet reflecting the accepted 25% and Net-60 (acme_signed_term_sheet.pdf). Please confirm next steps for Marketplace onboarding and when we can expect the private offer to be created in AWS.

Best,
Sophie
attachments: [acme_signed_term_sheet.pdf]
